description: Cross-device workspace for sharing screens, apps, files, clipboard, input, calls, and notifications across Windows, macOS, Linux, and Android.
notes: Review status: the stable v2.4.0 x64 and ARM64 setup assets and their SHA-256 digests are verified. The newer v2.5.0-beta.1 is a pre-release, so this manifest tracks the latest stable release.

The upstream build uses NSIS per-machine installation with elevation. Its custom installer modifies Firewall rules, the WebClient registry setting, TrustedPeople certificate store, and Windows integration for optional calls and virtual-camera features; uninstall performs corresponding system cleanup.
This manifest downloads the vendor setup only. No Scoop install or uninstall hooks are enabled until every system-wide change and cleanup path can be handled safely and tested.
